name: Chefi la cuțite
description: The show is the Romanian version  of  "Game of Chefs", a competition open for both amateur and professional chefs, competing for the title of "Romania's most talented chef". The show has four stages: The blind auditions, training camp, kitchen battles, and finals.

videos.title: Epsiode 1
videos.overview: The first episode of a new cooking show that features the three judges that left MasterChef Romania. The novelty of this show is represented by the blind test taste.
